name: Historic Fortified City of Carcassonne
description: Carcassonne's Cité is a hilltop medieval citadel in southern France, rising above the right bank of the Aude river in the Occitanie region. Double rings of massive walls and pointed towers surround a castle, narrow lanes and a Gothic cathedral, on a hill fortified since before Roman times. Much of its fairy-tale look comes from the 19th-century restoration led by architect Viollet-le-Duc.
